declared_changes.description: Added a new finding of mild scoliosis which is not supported by the images.

rationale: The original report states that bony structures are intact. I introduced a fabrication error by adding a new finding of 'mild scoliosis' in the findings section. This finding is not supported by the provided images, which show a straight spine. This creates a clinically meaningful error by reporting a condition that is not present.
